profile.ja: 紅血卿、カーラ・クロムウェル（Cara Cromwell）。魔界を支配する９つの有力貴族の一角で、魔界北部中央に広大な領地を有する吸血鬼。ノマドを率いるエドウィン・ブラックの姉。側近に金竜騎士団を率いる魔界騎士マリカ・クリシュナがいる。
profile.en: Cara Cromwell, known as the Crimson Blood Knight, is a vampire who holds a vast domain in the northern central Demon Realm and is one of the nine powerful nobles that dominate the Demon Realm. They are Edwin Black's older sibling, who leads the Nomads, and have the demon knight Marika Krishna, leader of the Golden Dragon Knights, as a close aide.

text.ja: 我が名はカーラ・クロムウェル。紅血卿とも呼ばれているわ。……ふふ、“弟よ”と呼びかけるべきかしら？
text.en: My name is Cara Cromwell. I'm also called the Crimson Blood Knight. … Heh, should I call you "little brother"?

text.ja: 魔界の勢力争いはなにも魔界でのみ行われているわけではないわ。人間界での小競り合いはあなたも心当たりがあるでしょ？
text.en: The power struggles in the Demon Realm aren't confined there. You've had your share of skirmishes in the Human Realm, haven't you?

text.ja: 大勢従者がいるようだけれど、優秀な従者が１人いればそれで十分ではないかしら？　醜く争う事もないでしょうし……
text.en: You may have many retainers, but wouldn't one outstanding retainer be enough? No need for ugly squabbles…

text.ja: 私自身の立場は重々承知した上で、同時にこうして知見を広める事も大事よ。マリカはなにか言いたい事があるようだけど
text.en: I fully understand my own position, and at the same time, spreading knowledge like this is important. Marika seems to have something she wants to say.

text.ja: そんなに畏まらなくてもいいわ。ただ、『姉さん』とは呼ばない方がいいみたいね。すごい殺気が放たれているから
text.en: You don't need to be so formal. Just… don't call me "big sis." I can feel a massive killing intent radiating.

text.ja: 対魔忍……懐かしい響きね。魔の者である私達とは相容れないはずなのに、彼女は……ふふふ、昔の話よ
text.en: Taimanin… such a nostalgic sound. We, beings of the demon, shouldn't get along, yet she… hehe, that's a story from the past.

text.ja: ノマドと対魔忍が同盟を結んだと聞いた時は少し驚いたけれど……私の弟の判断、と考えたら理解は出来るわね
text.en: I was a bit surprised when I heard the Nomads and the Taimanin formed an alliance… but if I think of it as my younger sibling's decision, I can understand.

text.ja: こう見えても人間の知り合いは結構多いのよ。そうねえ……それこそあなたでも名は知っている実力者と知り合いかも知れないわ
text.en: Even though I look like this, I actually know quite a few humans. Hmm… I might even be acquainted with a powerhouse whose name you know.

text.ja: んぉおっ、ああっ……！　か、身体が火照るわっ……！　この私がこんなはしたない姿を晒すなんて……！
text.en: Nnnooo, ahh…! My body… it's heating up! I can't believe I'm exposing such a lewd side of myself!

text.ja: 魔界貴族なのによだれもマン汁も垂れ流しぃっ♪　その上ウンコまでひり出せっていうのっ！？　ああ、そんなのダメよぉっ！
text.en: Even though I'm a demon-realm noble… drooling and spilling my juices everywhere♪ And now you're even making me… poop!? Ah, that's just no good!

text.ja: ああ、マンコの疼きが止らないわっ……！　チンポでも触手でも、なんでも良いから早くぶち込んでほしいのっ……！
text.en: Ah, my pussy just won't stop throbbing... Whether it's a cock or a tentacle, anything—just shove it in already...!
